candidate_workaround: Supply a concise bounded --note value whenever promoting a Method Flow method state.
failure_signature: The Method Flow set-state command is invoked without its required --note option and exits before ledger mutation.
recurrence_guard: Preflight required CLI options and always include an evidence-bounded promotion note.
rollback: Retain the parser failure, leave the method unpromoted, and retry only after recording the missing-option guard.
scope_boundary: Method Flow metadata transition only; it does not strengthen the underlying evidence.
title: Explicit-note Method Flow state promotion
trigger_preconditions: A validated Method Flow method is ready for a state transition.
